name: While Loops
equipment: A computer with a JS runtime (a browser console, Node.js, or an online REPL like replit.com)
instructions: While loops repeat as long as a condition stays true.
Always make sure the condition eventually becomes false, or you get an infinite loop.
Type the example into a real file (or console/REPL), run it, then modify it until you understand why it behaves that way.
